title: Warm Peanut Pilaf
description: A comforting and flavorful pilaf dish made with peanuts and warm spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the peanuts and cook until lightly browned, about 2 minutes.
Add the pilaf rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the warm cumin, dutch mustard, and salt. Cook for an additional minute.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
